bpc.runtimeAdaptation: Use upstream custom/manifest.json in a temporary copy; JavaScript sources unchanged

llmfeeder.runtimeAdaptation: Unchanged sources run in an isolated world; preserve visible prose and annotations using scoped semantic clones, and use scoped full-page conversion for interactive reports and PDF text projections

publisherFallbacks.ft: Retry genuine publisher Facebook preview URLs for content and interactive articles, including validated original FT URLs from subscription redirects
publisherFallbacks.reuters: Look up a matching headline and publication date through Devdiscourse Search; verify the live headline and Reuters attribution, and include both source URLs
publisherFallbacks.native: When installed, agent-chrome runs isolated background native browsers with per-invocation ownership, scoped cleanup and HTTP error guards; native page HTML is processed by BPC and original PDF bytes may be captured directly

files.output: Original bytes by default; --native-files preserves original files in mixed Markdown batches
files.optionalPdfConversion: Poppler pdftotext into a page-by-page text projection processed by LLMFeeder full-page conversion
files.integrity: Preserve browser-modified download headers, validate PDF magic and complete byte ranges, and reject partial exports
